name: Position Map Voxelization
aliases: Voxelization via Position Map and 3D Image Store
definition: A post-processing voxelization step that reads a 2D position map (containing world-space positions of previously identified surface points) and writes active voxel indicators into a 3D volume texture. It marks the primary voxel and its 8 immediate neighbors as active to ensure connectivity or fill gaps.
summary: Position Map Voxelization converts pre-computed surface points into a 3D voxel grid by rasterizing a 2D position map into a volume texture, ensuring connectivity by marking primary voxels and their eight immediate neighbors as active.
